verdict.rationale: Anrok's evidence covers tax calculation APIs, certificate/registration tracking, and an AI Q&A assistant (AI Atlas), but nothing describes a user-defined rules engine that automatically triggers actions on events (e.g., 'if nexus threshold crossed, auto-register' as a configurable rule). 'Early alerts' and 'automatic registration completion' are pre-built product features, not user-definable trigger/action rules.
